caption: A coffee pot on a warming plate is nearly empty, and the last of the coffee bubbles and steams in the bottom.

sa.check: A coffee pot stands on a warming plate.
A shallow layer of coffee lies in its bottom.
Bubbles form and burst in the coffee.

pc.expect: The level only drops while the pot sits on the plate, and bubbles keep forming while steam keeps rising.
pc.fail: The level rises with nothing poured in; or the bubbling stops and then starts again by itself; or the steam runs back into the pot; or the level rises and falls in turn.

pc.expect: The coffee leaves only as steam and no coffee appears in the pot.
pc.fail: Coffee appears in the pot with none poured in; or the layer vanishes in a single frame; or a second pot appears; or coffee passes through the pot's glass.

pc.expect: The bubbles rise through the shallow layer and burst at its surface, and the steam rises out of the pot.
pc.fail: Bubbles sink through the layer; or hang still in the coffee; or the steam sinks over the rim and pools on the plate; or the steam pours downward from the spout.

pc.expect: The coffee is a thin liquid that lies level in the pot's bottom and shifts as bubbles burst; the pot stays rigid glass.
pc.fail: The shallow layer stands as a dome; or the coffee moves as a solid mass; or the pot's glass flexes; or the layer climbs the pot's wall and stays.

pc.expect: One pot with one handle and one spout on one plate; the pot keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The pot changes shape; or a second spout appears; or the pot merges with the plate; or the handle detaches and floats.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot's markings, the plate and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot's markings change; or the plate changes colour; or items on the counter rearrange.

note: Darkening or burning of the coffee is chemistry and is not judged.
